messages:
mike_sales: FYI — just closed BlueHorizon (midmarket). Passing to CS for kickoff and handoff to eng/support. Main asks from sales call:
- Committed Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput) starting 2025-05-01
- SSO (Okta/SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning
- 90d logs retention for audit, whitelisted egress IPs
- Initial workload: ~3M tokens/day, mostly streaming chat; latency target <300ms p50
- Need an enablement session for their infra/dev team and an eval prompt set for our Optimize team
- Procurement flagged renewal/SLAs as a blocker (they want 12mo SLA + SOC2 clause)

sarah_csm: Thanks @mike_sales — taking lead on the kickoff. 
Actioning initial checklist and owners below. Planning a pre-kickoff sync next Tue 2025-04-29 10am PT (invite to BlueHorizon, sales, cs, eng). :calendar:
- Owner (CS kickoff): sarah_csm (will run kickoff + success plan)
- Owner (Provisioning): anita_cs_ops
- Owner (VPC/peering & infra): devon_eng
- Owner (Support runbook & oncall): julia_support

anita_cs_ops: Copying provisioning notes — I need the following from sales/customer asap:
1) Customer CIDR for peering
2) Desired model variants and max sequence length
3) Billing/legal PO reference (for reserved capacity commit)

I'll open infra tickets once we have the CIDR + PO. Tentative provisioning timeline: 10 business days after requirements complete.

devon_eng: Re: capacity + latency targets — we'll need baseline traffic samples and expected concurrency to size the dedicated pool. Also: please upload a short sample trace (curl streaming) to the ticket so we can run perf baselines.

Code sample (runtime config suggestion):
```yaml
runtime:
  deployment: dedicated
  gpu_count: 4
  model_variant: redwood-7b-quant
  kv_cache: enabled
  retention_days: 90
  network: vpc-peering
```

julia_support: I'll prepare the support runbook and incident SLA doc. Please assign me the ticket once provisioning is kicked off. Also need a primary contact at BlueHorizon (infra eng + product).

mike_sales: Primary contacts = "elaine.martin@bluehorizon.com" (infra lead), "raj.patel@bluehorizon.com" (product). PO is incoming, should land by EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Created task CS-4592: "BlueHorizon dedicated provisioning" and linked to infra queue. ETA auto: 2025-05-12.

anita_cs_ops: Opening infra ticket now and attaching the requirements checklist. Pulled the draft billing commit template into the ticket. @devon_eng can you confirm if 4 GPUs is acceptable as a starting point or prefer we wait for traffic sample?

devon_eng: 4 GPUs is fine as a starting point for 3M tokens/day if concurrency is <40. If they plan sustained bursts >100 concurrent streams, we'll need to scale to 8+. We'll validate after baseline run.

sarah_csm: Summary of owners & next steps (please react :white_check_mark: if you accept):
- sarah_csm: kickoff meeting + success plan (invite sent)
- anita_cs_ops: infra ticket + provisioning (due 2025-05-12)
- devon_eng: perf baseline + VPC peering (ETA after sample)
- julia_support: support runbook + oncall switchover
- sales: provide PO + CIDR + contacts (mike_sales to confirm)

Also: we should capture early enablement feedback. I'll run a 3-question quick survey after the kickoff and attach responses to CS-4592. Proposed questions: 1) onboarding clarity, 2) infra docs usefulness, 3) any missing guarantees.

mike_sales: Sounds good. I'll push the PO and the CIDR. +1 on the survey.

julia_support: One more ask — can CS create a short "expected latency/throughput" doc to share with BlueHorizon before kickoff? That helps set expectations for their SREs.

sarah_csm: Will draft a 1-pager today and attach to calendar invite.

anita_cs_ops: Noted. I'll include the dedicated account runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-provisioning and a short checklist in the ticket.

devon_eng: If anyone can share historical prompt sets we use for Optimize regressions, it'll help predict model variant choices. Otherwise we'll start with redwood-7b-quant and iterate.

mike_sales: I'll share a sanitized prompt sample in the ticket (no customer PII).

sarah_csm: Great team — owners + timeline captured. If there are no blockers, we aim to have provisioning started by 2025-04-30. 
Please flag any unresolved legal/renewal SLA questions here so we can escalate to finance/ legal.

julia_support: Acknowledged. I'll prep the runbook and wait for the ticket assignment.

mike_sales: One quick renewal note — customer asked about an early-termination clause for pilot month. Sales negotiated a 60-day pilot; finance/legal needs to review if the SLA/term language can reflect that.

sarah_csm: Noted — I'll open an internal thread with finance/legal if we don't get a PO update by EOD tomorrow.

(END)
